description.en: The name of the SLS Logstore for real-time delivery.
The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project for real-time delivery.
The region of the SLS project for real-time delivery.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用本接口删除实时日志推送的logstore，无其他特殊使用说明，调用时请保证参数设置符合要求。

- 您可调用[DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~)查询Project、Logstore、Region参数信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to delete a Logstore used for real-time log delivery. Make sure that you set the parameters correctly.

- You can call the [DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~) operation to query the Project, Logstore, and Region parameters.

## QPS limits

The rate limit for this operation is 6,000 calls per minute for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-real-time-log-logstore --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project project_example --logstore logstore_example --biz-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveRealTimeLogLogstore --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --Logstore logstore_example --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
